features.name: Copilot Assisted Scheduling
features.description: PrintVis Copilot functionality that optimizes job scheduling across multiple machines. Users select machines, date range, and optimization criteria, then Copilot generates an optimized schedule.
caveats: Only demonstrated for print shop scheduling

features.name: Optimization Options
features.description: Configuration options for scheduling optimization such as avoiding paper changes on machines. Users can select specific criteria based on their business needs.

features.name: Schedule Loading
features.description: Feature to load the Copilot-generated optimized schedule into the planning board for execution. Applies optimization across multiple machines.

quotes.text: This is a demonstration of the print viz co-pilot assisted scheduling functionality.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clearly identifies the feature being demonstrated and its role in print shop operations.
